name: airesumeanalyzer
description: AI Resume Analyzer & Job Match Platform

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm ci --include=dev --prefix server && npm run prisma:generate --prefix server && npm ci --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.start: npm run migrate:deploy --prefix server && npm start --prefix server
